_comment: Copy to demo.config.json in your demo working directory and edit. Every value the harness needs that is specific to YOUR app lives here; nothing else does.
_comment_entry: entry_js is the React Native entry file, patched to remove the dev warning overlay during recording. Leave it "" for a non-RN app or if there is no overlay to remove.
_comment_ime: Disabled during recording: it stops the soft keyboard covering the screen AND makes `input text` deterministic. Restored in phase 6.
_comment_size: device = what `adb exec-out screencap` produces. video = the render size, same aspect ratio.
_comment_guard: screen_guard is a testID present on the screen being demoed and nowhere else - the recorder refuses to act without it, which is what stops one missed tap from wrecking a take. panel_close is the editor's close control, used by the `closepanel` action so it never taps blind. Leave "" if the screen has no panel.
